comment: The networks this app can be built for, one per binary. EXPO_PUBLIC_QRL_NETWORK_PROFILE selects the entry at build time (testnet when unset). services/NativeWalletProfile.ts, scripts/sync-embedded-web.sh and scripts/verify-embedded-web.js all read this file. An entry runs only once its chainId and genesisHash are both set; mainnet stays dormant until its identity is published.
